transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's this cough. It just won't go away and it's getting me down.
When did you first notice it?
Hard to say exactly... it's been a while now. It sort of came on after I had a cold.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
Cold air seems to set it off, and if I talk for a long while it starts up too. Steam helps a little, I think.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
I'm bringing up phlegm with it — white to yellowish stuff. More than the bit I usually get in the mornings.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's in my chest, mostly. I wouldn't say it spreads anywhere.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
I'm not great with numbers like that. It's bad enough that it's bothering me, I'd say.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It comes and goes. Worse in the mornings, and it wakes me at night too.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
I do get a bit more puffed than usual, even just walking to the shop.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I've got COPD — had it for about eight years now.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
Oh, a few inhalers and a tablet for my blood pressure. I'd have to check the names, I can never remember them.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, nothing that I know of. I've never had a problem with any medicine.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
I get a bit more puffed, and the night coughing tires me out. I'm probably not getting as much done as I'd like.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
Well... I do worry. My lungs have been getting worse over the years, and you hear things. I suppose I wonder if it could be something more serious.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
